semanticOwner: DpcmiMetadataContract remains the sole DPCMI decoder, while the hash-pinned NT51929/NT51932 family profile is the sole physical locator owner; the canonical capability policy and golden manifest retain their existing identity projections.
terminalContract: For supported Standard Merge NT51919, NT51929, and NT51932, DPCMI resolves only from CMD1 Page 0 [0x401A,0x401D), rooted at the declared [0x4004,0x401D) command anchor with relative offset 22. No reachable DP/DPCMI sub-version inspection may resolve below 0x100 or fall back to compact bytes [0x66,0x69). AB remains on its existing per-bank CMD Page ranges. General Merge remains without a DPCMI reader. The canonical-golden validator's 0x66-0x69 mention remains historical legacy-evidence-only, not a runtime or release authority.

designReview.evidence: ADR 0012 fixes NT51929/NT51932 DPCMI at 0x401A; ADR 0032 fixes perfect-family AB per-bank CMD Page ranges; ADR 0039 binds owner-backed perfect-family facts at 0x401A.
